answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock $350,000 in liquid collateral. Second, the agent's hardware enclave generates a unique, immutable cryptographic signature. Third, the validator set verifies this signature against the specific staked bond. An attacker would face costs of $350,000 per fake identity and 21 days of intensive compute verification. This mechanism is like attempting to hide a single onyx stone within a massive, wind-swept meadow of shifting shale; the heavy cost of every false move ensures truth.
